rows.en: Touya: "Have you finished getting your room sorted out?"
Kasumi: "Yes. I didn't have that much luggage anyway."
Touya: "What are you looking around for?"
Kasumi: "N-Nothing. You keep it pretty tidy."
Yamato: "Hey, Kasumi came all this way.
Aren't you going to offer her anything?"
Touya: "Huh? Even if you say that... Oh,
come to think of it, I've got just the thing."
Yamato: "You like chocolate, don't you, Kasumi?
Let's pick out the ones that are still okay and have her help us."
Kasumi: "I like chocolate, so I don't mind...
but that 'still okay' part worries me a little."
Yamato: "It's fine, it's fine. Wait right here."
Touya: "Don't worry so much. I've been doing my best
to eat them all before they expire.
I can't just throw them away, and there are a lot..."
